privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How your information is used on this website.
privacy.controllerBody: Ricardo Lopes EI is responsible for the information submitted through the contact form.
privacy.collectionBody: The form asks for your name, email address, project type and description. These fields are required: without them, the enquiry cannot be sent through this form. The page language is also submitted. These details are used to assess and respond to your enquiry, as pre-contractual steps taken at your request. They are not used for a newsletter.
privacy.processingBody: Messages are accessible to Ricardo Lopes and processed through Netlify Forms, the hosting and form provider. Processing may involve transfers outside the European Economic Area, subject to Netlify’s data processing agreement. Email service providers deliver notifications and replies.
privacy.retentionBody: Enquiries that do not lead to a project are deleted within 12 months of the last exchange. If a contract is agreed, the necessary data is retained in accordance with applicable obligations.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access, correction, deletion or restriction of your data, and portability where applicable. Write to the contact address listed on this page. You may also lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, CNIL.
privacy.cookiesBody: This site does not include advertising or audience analytics tools. A functional cookie remembers your chosen language for one year. Fonts and images are served from this website.
